verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a Personnel object with custom fields and reminders for personnel to complete security awareness training and policy acceptance. That covers the 'every hire got training' half of the story. Access reviews can mark accounts for revocation, but they are periodic reviews, an adjacent capability rather than offboarding-triggered access removal. Missing for 10: documented HR-system sync of hires and leavers, onboarding/offboarding checklist workflows, offboarding-triggered verification that leavers lost access, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
